about: Screenshots of the original Teeworlds 0.7.5 client (re/teeworlds/oracle/render/run.sh): Xvfb 1280x720x24, Mesa llvmpipe, the client's own screenshot command (F10), connected to the original teeworlds_srv on 127.0.0.1. Compare a port screenshot with: node re/teeworlds/oracle/render/compare.mjs <scene>.png <port>.png [side.png] [--tolerance 24]

player.name: tee
player.skin: default (the release's defaults, no custom colours)

client.camera: zoom 1.0; cl_dynamic_camera 0 (default): playing, the camera is centred on the local tee; spectating in free view, the camera is the controls' mouse position clamped to [200, mapwidth*32-200] x [200, mapheight*32-200] (no mouse movement: the map's top left, 200,200)

timing: the screenshot is taken <wait> seconds after the server logs 'player has entered the game' (plus key delivery, < 0.2 s); the round timer shows 0:03 or 0:04
reproducibility: two runs: mean absolute difference <= 0.01 per channel, 100% of pixels within tolerance 24

dm1-spawn.shows: the local tee 'tee' at dm1's first spawn point (one player: the first spawn), HUD with 10 hearts, 10 empty armour, 10 pistol ammo, timer, 'Warmup / wait for more players' broadcast, the score at the right

dm1-spectator.shows: tournament mode: the joining player is a spectator; free view at the map's top left (camera 200,200), 'Spectate: Free-View', timer

ctf1-spawn.shows: the tee in the red team at the red spawn, the red flag on its stand, team scores 0 / 0, timer, warmup broadcast
